tools.name: analyze_contributions
tools.description: Identify which processes (or flows) contribute most to an impact category — the hotspots. Requires result_id and impact_category_id (from calculate_impacts' impacts). Returns top contributors with share and absolute amount.
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: calculate_impacts
tools.description: Calculate environmental impacts for a product system. Returns a result_id, a compact ResultSummary (top impacts, suggested next actions), the full impact list, and any consistency warnings. IMPORTANT: call dispose_result when done with the result_id.
tools.operational_effect: Creates or computes temporary analysis state.

tools.name: check_result_consistency
tools.description: Sanity-check a stored calculation result: for every impact category, verify that per-process contributions sum to the reported total (within tolerance). A mismatch usually signals broken provider linking or a partially-computed result. Run this after calculate_impacts before trusting the numbers.

consistent.description: True if no warnings were found.

items.description: One string per inconsistency found; empty if consistent.

tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: compare_systems
tools.description: Compare two product systems on the same impact method. Returns per-category system1, system2, difference, and percent change. Runs and disposes both calculations internally (no result_id needed).
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: create_process
tools.description: Create a unit process with inputs and outputs. Each exchange: flow_id (id preferred, name accepted), amount, is_input, optional is_quantitative_reference, optional provider_id. The exchange amount is interpreted in the flow's REFERENCE unit (e.g. t*km for transport, kg for mass); pass optional 'formula' (e.g. '0.065*500') to store an amount formula, or 'unit_id'/'flow_property_id' to record the amount in a non-reference property the flow defines. Returns 'warnings' if the process's Mass-property inputs and outputs don't balance (openLCA does not check this automatically). WRITE: blocked on read-only connections.

items.description: Mass-balance warnings, if any; empty if balanced.

tools.operational_effect: Creates persistent entities in the openLCA database.

tools.name: create_product_flow
tools.description: Create a new product flow (Mass property, kg unit). Use to define the product under study or intermediate products. WRITE: blocked on read-only connections.
tools.operational_effect: Creates persistent entities in the openLCA database.

tools.name: create_product_system
tools.description: Create a product system from a process (auto-links providers). Returns the product system id for calculations. Provide process_id (preferred) or process_name. Optional cutoff (0-1, e.g. 0.05 for a 5% cut-off), default_providers ('prefer'|'only'|'ignore') and preferred_type ('LCI_RESULT'|'UNIT_PROCESS'). WRITE: blocked on read-only connections.
tools.operational_effect: Creates persistent entities in the openLCA database.

tools.name: dispose_all_results
tools.description: Dispose every tracked calculation result. Useful for cleanup at the end of a session.
tools.operational_effect: Deletes temporary calculation results from server memory.

tools.name: dispose_result
tools.description: Dispose a calculation result to free server memory. Always call this when finished with a result_id from calculate_impacts.
tools.operational_effect: Deletes temporary calculation results from server memory.

tools.name: export_results
tools.description: Export results to a file. With result_id: export its impacts to CSV (format=csv) or an Excel workbook (format=excel). With data + kind=comparison: export a compare_systems result to CSV. filepath is the output path on the server host.
tools.operational_effect: Writes a result file on the server host.

tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: Find all processes that produce a given flow. Provide flow_id (preferred) or flow_name. Use after search_flows to identify production processes for linking.
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: get_contribution_tree
tools.description: Build an upstream contribution (hotspot) tree for an impact category: nested process nodes with amount, direct contribution, and share. Requires result_id and impact_category_id. Pruned by max_depth and min_share.

items.description: Recursive node: name, amount, direct, share, ref, children[].

tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: get_entity_by_name
tools.description: Exact-name lookup of a single entity. Faster and more precise than keyword search when you know the exact name. Returns a compact {id, name, type, category} summary.

entity.description: Compact summary of the matched entity.

tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: get_inventory_results
tools.description: Get the life cycle inventory (elementary/environmental flows) for a calculated result. Requires result_id from calculate_impacts. direction filters input/output/both.
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: get_normalized_impacts
tools.description: Get normalized impact results (relative to the method's normalization set). Requires result_id. Empty if the method has no normalization set.
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: get_sankey
tools.description: Get Sankey-graph data (nodes + edges) for an impact category, suitable for visualization. Requires result_id and impact_category_id.

sankey.description: Graph data with nodes and edges.

tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: get_total_requirements
tools.description: Get the total requirements (scaled technology flows) of a calculated product system: which processes run and at what amount. Requires result_id.
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: get_weighted_impacts
tools.description: Get weighted impact results (after normalization + weighting). Requires result_id. Empty if the method has no weighting set.
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Health probe for the openLCA connection: whether the server is reachable and how much data the active database holds. Set count_entities=false to skip the counts.
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: run_monte_carlo
tools.description: Run Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis. Returns per-impact statistics (mean, std, CV, percentiles). Can be slow for large systems / high iteration counts.
tools.operational_effect: Creates or computes temporary analysis state.

tools.name: run_scenario_analysis
tools.description: Vary a single parameter over a list of values and report impacts for each value. Useful for sensitivity analysis.

scenarios.description: Map of parameter value -> impact rows.

tools.operational_effect: Creates or computes temporary analysis state.

tools.name: search_flows
tools.description: Search for material flows in the openLCA database. Keywords are case-insensitive and use partial matching (all keywords must be present). Example: keywords=['steel','hot','rolled'] finds 'Steel, hot rolled, coil'.
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: search_impact_methods
tools.description: Search for LCIA methods (TRACI, ReCiPe, CML, ILCD, EF, ...). Returns the matched method with its impact categories (id + name).
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: search_processes
tools.description: Search for processes (production, transport, ...) in the openLCA database. Keywords are case-insensitive with partial matching (all must match).
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Test connection to the openLCA IPC server. Use this first to verify openLCA is running and reachable. Returns connection status and port.
tools.operational_effect: Queries data or reads existing calculation state.
